results.explanation:
The report is a CLOSE_FP proposal, and the disposition follows from its evidence. Under the closure standard, the large-order test is read on O-00002353's own record, and the report does that. It executed 10501 before the opposite-side trade, a 0.6916 share, well above the one-tenth rule of thumb. Under the agency rule, the 379 SELL has a different parent order (C-T-X1009-01-B), so it is not part of the same round trip. Price move and reversion are both 0.0, so there is no benefit. Together these support genuine execution, with features (a) and (b) both absent.

Grounding is good. 6.37, 10501, 0.6916, 351, 4332, 379, -1.0, OTR 0.07, repetitions 1, parent ids and times all appear in the tool results. "About 40 partial fills" is an approximation; the events show 41, so it is acceptable.

There are some weaknesses:
- The order's placement time (09:28:38.528), the cancel time (09:29:05.528) and the 2000 ms gap from SELL to cancel are not stated explicitly. A reviewer must partly reconstruct the rest, fill, cancel sequence.
- Indicator wording is loose. Listing "opposite-side execution before the cancel" as not matched is muddled, because such an execution did occur; what was absent is the benefit. "Away from the touch (1 tick)" is also imprecise: the order joined or improved the bid. Cancel timing is not named as an indicator.
- The explanations list omits execution algorithm and stop-out. They are less relevant here, but not addressed. The supported explanation cites no evidence ids in its entry.

These are mostly presentation weaknesses. Grounding and consistency are sound.
results.label: Good
